bio: Gino D’Acampo and his team of chefs have created an Afternoon Tea with an Italian twist.  Enjoy a deli selection, including parma ham bruschetta and gourmet sandwiches. Freshly baked buttermilk scones are served with strawberry jam and Cornish clotted cream. The sweet treats include chocolate & hazelnut cheesecake, with Ferrero Rocher, and a lemon & blueberry tart.  Afternoon Tea is served daily between 12pm and 4pm, you have the choice of dining in the bar lounge area or take a seat in the open plan restaurant.  Gino D'Acampo Leeds is situated at the Marriott Hotel, in the heart of the city centre.
